interaction: Throw the main switch or flip each section's slide switch (SW2–SW6) to send current along copper SVG traces that are routed live between the page's components; each powered section lights up (chip pins, resistor bands, capacitor, LEDs), and the LED array previews four colour temperatures in a line-drawn room.
notes: Traces are re-routed on resize, font load and brand rename. The quote form ends in a demo toast; prices are labelled as samples.
